claims.statement: OpenAPI describes API query and body parameter contracts, while specific bounds are defined by the API.

claims.statement: HTTP semantics distinguish bad requests, conflicts, oversized content and unsupported media types.
Problem Details describes machine-readable HTTP errors using type, title, status and extensible members.
Idempotency keys identify one logical mutation so an identical replay can recover the prior result without duplicating effects.
